props.doc:
Render a panel body through a fixed tag allowlist.

Parsed with DOMParser into an inert document and walked, copying only the
tags and attributes on the list into fresh nodes. Not a filter over
innerHTML - the string never becomes live markup in this document at all.

A panel body is written by an engineer but filled from a vendor payload,
so it is attacker-influenceable by construction. The allowlist is what
lets an engineer write a formatted note without that being a script tag.
props.name: renderPanelBody

props.code:
const pane = document.querySelector('[data-name="stepDetail"], #step-detail');
if (!pane) return;
pane.textContent = [
  `node        ${step.node_id}  (${step.node_kind})`,
  `status      ${step.status}   attempt ${step.attempt}`,
  `worker      ${step.worker_id || "—"}`,
  `command     ${step.command_key || "—"}`,
  `duration    ${step.duration_ms ?? "—"} ms`,
  step.retry_of_step_id ? `retry of    ${step.retry_of_step_id}` : "",
  "",
  "input",
  JSON.stringify(step.input, null, 2),
  "",
  "output",
  JSON.stringify(step.output, null, 2),
  "",
  step.error ? `error       ${step.error.error_class}: ${step.error.message}` : "",
  "",
  "limits applied",
  Object.entries(step.limits_applied || {})
    .map(([limit, applied]) => `  ${applied ? "enforced" : "NOT enforced"}  ${limit}`)
    .join("\n"),
  "",
  "logs",
  (step.logs || []).join("\n"),
].filter(Boolean).join("\n");
